A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
